[EN] Fragment of Hope
[ES] Fragmento de esperanza
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We must save Muhrak!
[ES] ¡Debemos salvar a Muhrak!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Striktryssir's Horn
[ES] Cuerno de Striktryssir
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Obtain {@LinkCreature:38#45#Striktryssir}'s Horn at Barbtail Coulee.
[ES] Consigue el cuerno de {@LinkCreature:38#45#Striktryssir} en Barbtail Coulee.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring Striktryssir's Horn to {@LinkCreature:238#1100#Torsten}, near the pyramid at Thunder Hold.
[ES] Llévale el cuerno de Striktryssir a {@LinkCreature:238#1100#Torsten}, cerca de la pirámide en Thunder Hold.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the top of the pyramid.
[ES] Ve a la cima de la pirámide.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The relic fragment grants you its power!
[ES] ¡El fragmento de reliquia te otorga su poder!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the top of the pyramid on the right at Thunder Hold, then absorb the relic fragment's power.
[ES] Ve a la cima de la pirámide de la derecha en Thunder Hold y absorbe el poder del fragmento de reliquia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Grigelt's Wrath
[ES] Ira de Grigelt
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Obtain {@LinkCreature:35#1000#Grigelt}'s Wrath at Deathgorge.
[ES] Consigue la ira de {@LinkCreature:35#1000#Grigelt} en Deathgorge.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring Grigelt's wrath to Torsten, near the altar in Deathgorge.
[ES] Llévale la ira de Grigelt a Torsten, cerca del altar en Deathgorge.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the top of the altar.
[ES] Ve a la cima del altar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Behold the relic fragment's power!
[ES] ¡Contempla el poder del fragmento de reliquia!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Deathgorge and bring the relic fragment to the altar to release its power.
[ES] Ve a Deathgorge y lleva el fragmento de reliquia al altar para liberar su poder.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go back to the altar and speak with Torsten again.
[ES] Regresa al altar y habla con Torsten de nuevo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm ready! Do it!"
[ES] ¡Estoy listo! ¡Hazlo!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Torsten, near the teleportal in Blood Valley.
[ES] Ve con Torsten, cerca del teleportal en Blood Valley.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Jester's Villa
[ES] Villa del Bufón
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You sense the presence of Killian, God of Terror, nearby...
[ES] Sientes la presencia de Killian, Dios del Terror, cerca...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] {@LinkCreature:236#1006#Teleport} in, eliminate Killian, and retrieve the last relic fragment.
[ES] {@LinkCreature:236#1006#Teleúntate}, elimina a Killian y recupera el último fragmento de reliquia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate Killian's pet, Snaharzim.
[ES] Elimina a la mascota de Killian, Snaharzim.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thanks."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go back to Commander Fraya at Allemantheia Headquarters and tell her you have three of the four relic fragments. [Speak with {@linkcreature:72#1103#Arshadh} to enter the Allemantheia Headquarters.]
[ES] Regresa con la Comandante Fraya en el Cuartel General de Allemantheia y dile que tienes tres de los cuatro fragmentos de reliquia. [Habla con {@linkcreature:72#1103#Arshadh} para entrar al Cuartel General de Allemantheia.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll find the blacksmith."
[ES] Encontraré al herrero.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go back to Kaiator and tell Kaia at Kaiator Command Center that you have three relic fragments and a substitute for the fourth. [Speak with {@linkcreature:84#1088#Yunari} to enter.]
[ES] Regresa a Kaiator y dile a Kaia en el Centro de Mando de Kaiator que tienes tres fragmentos de reliquia y un sustituto para el cuarto. [Habla con {@linkcreature:84#1088#Yunari} para entrar.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Tamur at Kaiator Command Center and receive information of the legendary blacksmith.
[ES] Ve con Tamur en el Centro de Mando de Kaiator y recibe información sobre el herrero legendario.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
